Background:
My journey into holistic wellbeing began in the early 2000s, guided by a deep curiosity about the connection between mind, body, and spirit. Through study, lived experience, trusted mentors, and many healing modalities, I came to understand that true healing is both inward and in the everyday moments.

My own “dark night of the soul” opened the doorway to energy healing, meditation, spiritual mentoring, and holistic counselling—tools that supported me through life’s many seasons of love, loss, change, and transformation. Along the way, I learned the gift of turning inward, asking for support, trusting myself, and remembering my own enoughness. 

To take the wisdom of the spiritual & practically apply it to this very real human existence. This is what I now support others to discover & rediscover.

Healing Philosophy:
Healing doesn’t have to be mysterious. It’s not about becoming someone new. It’s about releasing what no longer serves you. You already carry wisdom within you. My role is to help you remember it — to build your inner toolbox, deepen self-awareness and live grounded in your truth. You heal by releasing, not suppressing. 
Learn who you are.
Unlearn who they told you to be.



What I Hold Space for:
Gain understanding of old pain and the wisdom it holds for you
Discover ways to feel safe within so the healing can hold
Expanding intuition and self-trust, spirituality within the human experience
Living authentically, gently, truthfully, joyfully

Each of my sessions are as unique as the individual. Because there is no “one method fixes all”! 
When your energy is nurtured, mentally and spiritually, clarity returns. 
Your nervous system needs to remember safety to soften, then your inner wisdom can once again speak louder than fear. 
For me, each session is a gentle unfolding. 
Intuitive. Grounded. Led by what you need in the moment.
Life is messy. Beautiful. Wildly human.

Whilst I love all things spiritual and mind body spirit, I think the greatest gift is integrating the knowledge of energy and spirituality, to make this human experience an enriching one. 

We are after all, here, living a very human life. So why not bring some wisdom and magic into it to see what else is possible?!
